article.headline: Francis’ 19 lead Le Moyne past Manhattan 76-62
article.description: — Ty Francis scored 19 points as Le Moyne beat Manhattan 76-62 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Francis’ 19 lead Le Moyne past Manhattan 76-62
article.story: SYRACUSE, N.Y. -- — Ty Francis scored 19 points as Le Moyne beat Manhattan 76-62 on Saturday. Francis had eight rebounds and three blocks for the Dolphins (2-2). Leandro Gysel shot 6 for 11, including 4 for 9 from beyond the arc to add 16 points. Trevor Roe shot 5 for 13, including 1 for 7 from beyond the arc to finish with 11 points, while adding six rebounds. Ben Pearce led the way for the Jaspers (1-3) with 16 points and two steals. Josiah Sabino added 15 points for Manhattan. Ben Tweedy finished with 11 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
